data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has benefitted from releasing Covid-19 related reserve from older years of account based on ground up exposure analysis exercise carried out, as well as prior-year catastrophe reserve releases for several events including Typhoon Hagibis, Typhoon Faxai, Typhoon Jebi, UK EU flooding and Winter Storm Uri. These releases exceeded current year losses due to the benign claims experience.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104 recorded a gross prior-year release of $17.35m in 2023 (approximately 27.1% of opening gross claims outstanding of $64.04m). Management attributes the release primarily to reductions in COVID-19 related reserves and favourable prior-year development, including prior-year catastrophe reserve releases for events such as Typhoon Hagibis, Faxai, Jebi, UK/EU flooding and Winter Storm Uri. Although the 2023 year picked up catastrophe losses (for example Hawaii wildfires and Hurricane Idalia), the prior-year releases exceeded current-year losses, resulting in a net release overall. The movement predominantly affects the reinsurance/property exposure of the Syndicate.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are reported in the syndicate's functional currency (USD). Opening reserves derived from the balance sheet (Claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2022). Prior-year development taken from Technical Provisions note showing an over-provision/(release) of (17,350) in the Insurance liabilities column. Line-of-business attribution is inferred (Syndicate 6104 is a reinsurance vehicle focusing on property catastrophe ceded from Syndicate 33); the report does not split the prior-year movement by LOB. Several named prior events are cited in narrative but specific years for those events are not stated in the text; event-year fields left null where the report did not explicitly state the year. Claims development triangle is present (gross, $000 units).
